---
title: "복합시제(과거진행)"
date: 2019-10-02
categories: [English, Grammar]
description: "과거의 어느 한 시점에서 어떤 상황이나 동작이 진행되고 있는 경우"
---

## '과거' 그리고 '진행'
* 과거의 어느 한 시점에서 어떤 **상황**이나 **동작**이 진행되고 있는 경우
    * I [was watching]{.underline} TV when you called me last night.
    * I don't know. I [wasn't listening]{.underline}.
    * What [were]{.underline} you [doing]{.underline} at three o'clock?

## always
* When he worked here, Ryan [was always making]{.underline} mistakes.

## 공손한 표현 (iii)
* I [was wondering]{.underline} if you could help me out.
* I [was hoping]{.underline} we could dance together.
* I [was hoping]{.underline} we could have dinner together.

*** 

* Reference: 
    * 오성호. (2006). *Again! 뒤집어본 영문법*. 김영사.
